This pyramid has 365 steps and a serpent made of light. 🐍☀️ Watch Chichén Itzá's El Castillo go up in 22 seconds. ⏱️

First the Maya built a smaller pyramid, with a red jaguar throne inside. Then they built a bigger one right over it: square terraces, and four stairways of about 91 steps each. Add the platform on top and you get 365, one for every day of the year.

The twist: at the spring and autumn equinox, the late-afternoon sun casts triangles of light down the north stairway's balustrade, like a serpent crawling down to the stone serpent heads at its base.

Would you go see it on the equinox? Yes or no 👇

yt_title: This Pyramid Has 365 Steps and a Serpent Made of Light #shorts
yt_description:
El Castillo (Temple of Kukulcán), Chichén Itzá, built c. 8th–12th centuries CE over an earlier pyramid (excavated 1931–36: Chac Mool, red jaguar throne). Square terraces, base 55.3 m, 24 m + 6 m temple; four stairways of ~91 steps + the top platform = 365 (the Haab' year). At the equinoxes, late-afternoon sun casts triangular shadows on the northwest balustrade, like a serpent crawling down to the serpent heads.

Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/El_Castillo,_Chichen_Itza · https://world.new7wonders.com/wonders/pyramid-at-chichen-itza-before-800-a-d-yucatan-peninsula-mexico/
Figures are historical estimates. Stylised 3D animation.
